Synthetic test fixture created for this project, not a photograph from a camera.
synthetic.dng: 32x24, uncompressed 16-bit RGGB CFA, DNG 1.4, identity ColorMatrix1, white level 65535, no embedded preview.
Purpose: exercise real LibRaw Unicode-path opening, no-preview fallback, full rendering, allocation checks and cleanup.
This does not establish camera/model or compressed RAW coverage.
Fixture is original project test data and may be used under the project MIT license.
